Usage: resecta-data build negative-corpus [OPTIONS]

  Build the deterministic no-PII negative corpus (the baseline FP surface).

  Emits ``corpus/negative_corpus.json``: benign documents that contain no valid PII, so any
  detection the engine surfaces against them is a false positive. Dev/eval fixture; not installed to
  the Swift Resources path.

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY  [required]
  --seed INTEGER         [default: 20260416]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
